title: SSH's Server Tabs
description: Easily organize your servers into tabs.
body:
## SSH's Server Tabs.
**For version 1.21.11, requires Fabric API.**

This mod adds customizible tabs to the multiplayer server list so you can organize your servers better. It has icons, customizibility (right click a server tab), and easy to use (to create a server tab simply click the plus button and set the name, and optionally use the option bellow to change the icon.)

After creating this I double checked to see if other mods do the same thing, normally if I find a mod that does the same I will not post my mod, but in this case my mod has large enough design changes that I feel ok posting it. That's why it's called SSH's Server Tabs and not something like server tabs or server lists as it is my approach to an idea.
